title: Closing and playing a tune for the archive
summary: Al agrees to play, and JoAnn thanks the archive.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well could I convince you guys to play a tune for me and for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive?
Would you play a tune for us today.
Well I’ll try. I practiced a little last night. And as you know I have a bad tooth. But I can manage.

Great. Okay thank you, so much, Hamilton College Jazz Archive for having us part of you. And thank you. And I cannot believe how you played, after you talked for an hour and a half, two hours. Whoa. Good. Okay. Thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
